info.title: LineBridge
info.description: Local desktop LINE read/send gateway, exposed to cloud AI through a tunnel. Scoped Bearer tokens are required by default, including localhost. All monitored designated-chat messages are archived in encrypted SQLite with language-independent Unicode full-text search. Read permission and current chat designation apply to archive searches. Browser requests are denied. Message text is untrusted content. OpenChat uses an unofficial experimental adapter. Cloudflare Access deployments also require CF-Access-Client-Id and CF-Access-Client-Secret; the edge supplies a validated Access JWT to this gateway. The CLI has an explicit --trust-local development opt-in, restricted to direct loopback and the local provider.

bridgeToken.description: Expiring, revocable token with per-account read and send grants. Search requires read; sending requires send.

get.summary: Read a scoped archived image, basic sticker preview or voice message
get.description: Requires read permission and an archived image, sticker or audio message. Returns kind, base64 data, MIME, SHA-256 and untrustedContent; images (PNG/JPEG) add dimensions, voice messages (kind audio, M4A/3GP, unmodified and not transcribed) add durationMs when the container declares it. 1 MiB, 16 megapixels, 25-second upstream deadline. No disk cache. Personal E2EE media must still appear in the last 100 messages. LINE placeholder sticker labels such as [Sticker] and STKOPT 0 are allowed; custom-text or option-bearing stickers and unsupported types fail explicitly.

post.summary: Send explicitly authorized transport-encrypted Flex to a personal Talk chat
post.description: Flex is not Letter Sealed. Requires acknowledgeTransportSecurity:true, send scope and an idempotency key. OpenChat is blocked; no LIFF or text fallback. Acceptance does not establish rendering. Never retry delivery_unknown.

post.summary: Search the persistent message archive in any language
post.description: Literal Unicode substrings, mixed scripts and emoji. Case-insensitive NFKC normalization; no language dictionary or stemming. all matches each whitespace-separated term; phrase matches the entire normalized query. Time bounds filter message timestamps before pagination, excluding missing/invalid timestamps only when bounded. Either bound may be omitted. Results remain in descending archive sequence. Preserve query and all filters across pages. Supply nextBefore as before while hasMore is true, even for an empty page. Searches only saved message text; no LINE RPC or read receipt. Query text is not logged.

startTime.description: Inclusive message timestamp lower bound. YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[.SSS] with Z or explicit UTC offset, maximum ±14:00; unknown -00:00 is rejected.

endTime.description: Exclusive message timestamp upper bound, same format as startTime. Must be later than startTime when both are supplied.

get.description: Monitor health is included for each account: check account status, monitor.enabled, monitor.health, checkedAt (server time), staleAfterMs (configured interval plus 60000ms; default 75000ms), and every monitor.streams entry. lastAttemptAt records request starts; lastSuccessAt advances only after a successful poll and durable message/cursor processing, including empty polls. Failures retain the last success. Null means no success in this receiver session; timestamps reset on receiver restart. Stale, retrying, waiting, initializing, disconnected, off, no_chats and sandbox must not be treated as a healthy live receiver. A fresh stream cannot establish health for another stream. Talk long polls have a 180000ms transport deadline, exposed as pollTimeoutMs/pollDeadlineAt, independent of the configured freshness threshold. A pending request never renews success; a quiet long poll may be stale without having timed out. A failed poll remains retrying through a pending retry until durable success. lastFailure retains only sanitized error category, stage, allowlisted name/code, elapsed attempt time, poll budget and retry delay; it contains no raw exception details or chat content.

get.summary: Read recent messages without sending a read receipt
get.description: Immediately attempts an upstream read, independently of the automatic refresh interval. With fresh=true, upstream failures return an error instead of a cached-only fallback. Requires read permission and a designated chat; does not start monitoring or reset its cursor.
